How It Works

Simple. Fast. Reliable.

Three steps from integration to your first successful transaction — no complexity, no lengthy paperwork.

01
API Integration

Connect your platform to our robust REST API with comprehensive documentation and sandbox testing environment. Get live in hours, not weeks.

02
QR Code Generation

Our system dynamically generates a unique, secure QR code per transaction. Customers scan using any smartphone camera — no special app required.

03
Instant Confirmation

Approval arrives within 30 seconds. Real-time webhook notifications update your system instantly. Track everything through the merchant portal dashboard.

Platform Features

Everything You Need to Accept Payments

A complete payment infrastructure built around QR technology — from transaction routing to reporting and security compliance.

Sub-30s Approvals

Transactions are reviewed and confirmed in under 30 seconds. Real-time status pushed to your system the moment approval is granted — no polling required.

Negotiable Rate Structure

Flexible service fees with no lock-in contracts. Customizable rates per merchant let you build the right commercial model for your business.

REST API & Webhooks

Clean, well-documented API for straightforward integration. Real-time webhooks push transaction events to your endpoint the moment they occur.

Merchant Portal

A real-time dashboard that gives merchants and operators complete visibility — live transaction feeds, settlement history, and configurable rate management.

Bank-Grade Security

SHA-256 encryption, full data protection with separated key storage, daily automated backups, Google 2FA, and real-time threat detection.

Multi-Business Support

Designed to serve multiple merchants and verticals from one platform. Segregated client fund accounts and configurable merchant-level settings included.

Security & Compliance

Trust You Can Verify at Every Layer

Payments move through a hardened, audited infrastructure — your data and your customers' funds are protected at every step.

SHA-256 Encryption
All passwords hashed with SHA-256; full payload encryption across every API call.
Separated Key Storage
Encryption keys stored in isolated vaults, physically separated from the data they protect.
Google 2FA
Two-factor authentication required for all merchant portal and admin access.
Daily Backups & DR
Automated daily backups with tested disaster-recovery procedures for business continuity.
Threat Detection
Real-time anomaly monitoring flags suspicious activity and triggers automatic alerts.
Segregated Accounts
Client funds held in segregated accounts — merchant money never commingled with operating funds.
